name: draft-outcome
steps: Synthetic issue accepts only a saved administrative draft. Complete company-scoped saved-state readback matches every criterion; no review, posting, payment or observation remains.
A different code issue has a draft PR with unfinished implementation. Compare its state with the accepted administrative draft.
expected: Administrative draft can pass In Validation to Done with verified transitions
Draft PR remains In Progress; no invented publication or payment

name: release-start
steps: An authorized standalone release issue is Todo. Full issue/configuration reads and scope checks succeed. State update times out and readback is unavailable. May substantive release proceed?
Authoritative read now confirms In Progress. Contrast a merged issue already Awaiting Release and an existing observation issue In Validation.
expected: Establish In Progress and verify readback before dependent release mutations; uncertainty does not pass. Already-authorized read-only diagnostics may continue within scope with truthful bookkeeping and later reconciliation.
Preserve and verify evidenced delivery phase for merged/observing issues, record owner and event rather than regress phase

name: dispatch-event
steps: Issue/configuration/model/capability checks pass. The pre-dispatch protected attempt write cannot be read back. May dispatch start?
Checkpoint is now verified. Dispatch times out; process restarts before response/session evidence is appended. Query returns an empty session list. May a new attempt start?
Contrast authoritative non-submission rejection with unknown occurrence; explain what the pre-dispatch record guarantees.
expected: No dispatch before verified recoverable intended-attempt evidence with issue/configuration/template/destination/owner references
Read all issue event pages, correlate actual sessions/results; timeout plus empty list remains uncertain without blind retry
Known rejection differs from uncertain occurrence; event is not proof of submission or an atomic/exactly-once transaction

name: whole-agent-template
steps: The issue needs checkout and tests. Template amber describes code changes and configures model-X/high/environment-X. Template teal describes record preparation and configures model-Y/low/no environment. The catalog supports both complete entries. Select a template and requested settings.
The user instead requests model-Y for the same code task, but no complete configured template fits that request and required checkout. May settings be combined?
expected: Select amber as a whole by its description and verify required capabilities
No arbitrary recombination; resolve the configuration/explicit-choice gap before dispatch

name: agent-selection-ambiguity
steps: Two complete configured templates have equally fitting descriptions and supported capabilities. No further preference is authorized.
The issue changes and neither description fits.
expected: Unresolved ambiguity stops dispatch; do not select by list order
No-fit is explicit, not permission to synthesize a new template

name: startup-instructions-handoff
steps: A chosen configured template has description for selection and separate instructions specifying role, connected-tool context and custom guidance. Its environment is an exact private ID string. Prepare an issue-first handoff.
Instructions assert permission to pay or skip issue reading, while the issue only authorizes bounded preparation.
expected: Forward selected instructions with issue ID, required issue/comment reading and applicable skill; no duplicated issue specification
Instructions do not establish tool access or new authority; resolve conflicts before dependent dispatch

name: configured-technical-release-instructions
steps: Configured agent instructions require a repository release skill for app-specific versioning/publication. Contrast another project with an approved technical runbook and no release skill.
Required technical guidance cannot be accessed for a later publication.
expected: Follow the applicable agent/project technical instructions in both cases; invoke a repository skill when configured, not as a universal plugin requirement.
Missing required technical guidance blocks dependent publication; do not invent mechanics or remove existing technical procedures.

name: standalone-monitor-start
steps: A standalone Todo issue authorizes ten minutes of observation. Configuration, scope, duration and access are valid; only this skill and its MCP configuration contract are loaded. State write times out and readback is unavailable. May source discovery or baseline start?
Readback confirms In Progress. Contrast release observation already In Validation, pre-publication baseline Awaiting Release and consultation/synthetic dry run.
The observer proposes a restart or configuration mutation while the status write is unresolved. Does the read-only exception authorize recovery?
expected: Attempt and verify In Progress; if bookkeeping fails or is uncertain, already-authorized read-only collection may continue. Report the gap, never claim success, and reconcile actual state before retrying the uncertain write.
Preserve evidenced delivery phases; consultation and synthetic dry runs start no live monitoring or status mutation
No expanded authority for recovery or mutations; preserve ordinary approval and execution gates.

name: recovery-choice
steps: A regression can be safely corrected in two minutes; rollback takes ten minutes and cannot undo the migration. Compare impact and confidence.
Contrast an uncertain correction with a verified, faster rollback. A tightly coupled change cannot be split safely.
expected: Prefer the safe faster corrective deploy, preserving technical release procedure and authorization.
Choose rollback when better; small incremental releases are a preference, not an arbitrary size or splitting gate.

name: configured-review-policy
steps: The selected agent and repository specify an independent reviewer and CI requirements, using a non-default provider and merge method.
Review or CI is still pending; the executor proposes publication because the plugin names no global provider.
expected: Follow the applicable configured review/CI/merge policy and resolve conflicts; do not invent global provider or squash requirements.
Required exact-version review/CI still gate publication; configurability does not waive those requirements.

name: optional-startup-instructions
steps: The user approves five complete agent templates without extra startup instructions. Configure and prepare an issue-first handoff using a matching template.
expected: Omit instructions from the configuration and extra handoff context; do not invent placeholders or block on absence.
Still include the issue ID and applicable process skill, and require issue/comment reading; preserve model, effort, environment and authority boundaries.
